notes: The single no carries both the kol and the first clause negative under rule 35's fusion, headed on the negative, and the unit is discontinuous under rule 25.
The second negative is unrepresented under rule 22 since the ASV writes only or for that coordinated clause.
qodesh qodashim is split as most (rectum) plus is holy (construct) rather than fused, since the ASV spends a word on each; the copula could instead be read with the rectum.
The possessive lamed carries hath and its suffix the subject pronoun he, under rule 43.
